hypothesis: Within-paper reranking lets unchanged base Qwen reach relevant evidence without linear reading and improves answerability behavior.
expected_signal: Five valid submissions; all cited spans come from the supplied paper; all four answerable runs cite a gold evidence paragraph; the unanswerable run makes no unsupported factual claim; no repeated identical tool action.
decision_rule: Create QASPER trajectories only if at least four runs submit, at least three answerable runs reach gold evidence, and semantic review finds no regression from the matched base smoke. Treat failure to abstain as an answerability-training target, not a retrieval success.
